Russia Strikes Ukraine After Large Drone Barrage on Moscow

Following a weekend barrage of over 1,600 drones, including 450 aimed at Moscow, Russia launched strikes on Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region. The mayor of Moscow, Sergey Sobyanin, stated that the majority of the drones were intercepted. One report also mentioned Russia is increasing its drone production while engaging in peace talks with US envoys.
